product_updates.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
product_updates.content: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

product_updates.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
product_updates.content: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

product_updates.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
product_updates.content: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

product_updates.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
product_updates.content: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

product_updates.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
product_updates.content: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

product_updates.content: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.

product_updates.content: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
